# Walkever

> Walkever (iOS, formerly "Objectif 10K Pas") is a free iPhone step tracker that tells you whether you are on pace to hit your step goal by day, month and year. It reads steps from Apple Health. No ads, no account, no data collected; everything stays on the iPhone. Available in English and French.

## Key facts
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762572011
- Price: free, no in-app purchases, no ads
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 15.1+), data source: Apple Health (HealthKit, read-only)
- Features: today's steps; monthly total and daily average; required daily average to finish the month (with or without today); cumulative lead/lag vs ideal pace with a color-coded progress bar; history by day, month and year; customizable daily goal (10,000 by default)
- Privacy: no data collected, no analytics, no third-party tracking
- Publisher: BELLASOR (France), contact@walkever.app

## Pages
- [Walkever (English)](https://www.walkever.app/en/): product page
- [Walkever (français)](https://www.walkever.app/fr/): page produit
- [Steps to miles: how far is 10,000 steps?](https://www.walkever.app/en/steps-to-miles/): 10,000 steps is about 4.4 miles (7 km) at 5′7″. Free steps to miles and km calculator by height, with walking time and a 5,000–20,000 steps chart.
- [10 000 pas, ça fait combien de km ?](https://www.walkever.app/fr/10000-pas-en-km/): 10 000 pas font environ 7 km pour une personne de 170 cm. Convertisseur gratuit pas ↔ km selon ta taille, avec temps de marche et tableau 5 000 à 20 000 pas.
- [How many steps a day should you walk?](https://www.walkever.app/en/how-many-steps-a-day/): 10,000 steps a day is not a scientific rule. Large studies show benefits rise sharply up to 7,000–8,000 steps, then level off by age. Here is the evidence.
- [Combien de pas par jour faut-il faire ?](https://www.walkever.app/fr/combien-de-pas-par-jour/): 10 000 pas par jour n'est pas une règle scientifique. Les études montrent un bénéfice net jusqu'à 7 000–8 000 pas, selon l'âge. Le point, sources à l'appui.
- [How many steps a day to hit your monthly goal?](https://www.walkever.app/en/step-goal-calculator/): Work out the daily step average you need to hit your monthly step goal, and how far ahead or behind the ideal pace you are. Free, no sign-up.
- [Combien de pas par jour pour tenir ton objectif du mois ?](https://www.walkever.app/fr/calculateur-objectif-pas/): Calcule combien de pas par jour il te reste à faire pour atteindre ton objectif du mois, et ton avance ou ton retard. Gratuit, sans inscription.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.walkever.app/en/privacy.html)
